india.one_line: OpenAI expands its India leadership, while Sarvam AI launches a domestic token service for open-weight models.

themes.title: OpenAI expands India leadership role
themes.text: OpenAI appointed Pragya Misra to lead business development for India and South Asia, noting that India is its largest market with over 100 million weekly users.

stories.headline: OpenAI names Pragya Misra to lead business development in India and South Asia

themes.title: Sarvam AI launches domestic token service
themes.text: Sarvam AI launched Token Factory, serving global open-weight models and its own Sarvam 105B model on GPU clusters in India.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI opens Token Factory to run global open-weight models on Indian servers

themes.title: Meta updates Instagram algorithms in India
themes.text: Following regulatory scrutiny, Meta updated Instagram's recommendation systems in India using advanced AI to filter out violent and suggestive content.

stories.headline: Meta modifies Instagram recommendation systems in India to curb violent content
